_doc: Canonical mapping between Phoenix's `delegations.delegation_id` (string column) and the on-chain Kernel v3 Permission Validator's `bytes32 permissionId`. Captured by GitHub #57; consumed by the cryptographic revoke wired in #58. Pre-#58 grants emit `del_*` placeholder ids that pre-date Kernel provisioning and are NOT covered by this mapping; post-Kernel-provisioning grants emit the hex form below.

encoding.rule: delegation_id is the lowercase hex form of the bytes32 permissionId, including the 0x prefix
